title: Creating a Space is a step-by-step wizard that reads the plan from /pricing (LIVE-1201)

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21: use the standardized seeders' strategy to create a Space Creation Wizard. Analysis at /mnt/project-files/seeders/seeders-analysis-2026-10-21.md.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE RE-TESTED: /spaces/new was one plain form that read only ?mode= and had no plan question. It is now four Spark-kit steps (What do you want to do here, Tool setup, Name it, Ready) whose middle steps are read off SPACE_MANIFEST by lib/spaces/create-wizard.ts. It reads ?plan= (free, business, collective, nonprofit, network; unknown means free) from the /pricing hand-off. The plan is a hint: the Space is born free, and a paid hint is kept on the Space as preferences.planIntent and ends the setup walk on its billing page. Every existing path still works: ?mode= funnels, createSpace's gates, governed create, the setup walk. Starter content is the preset, tool defaults, CRM stages and kind from LIVE-1200 plus the existing setup walk; no invented sample content. Owner 2026-10-21: the plan question confused people, so step one is a multi-select of what the owner wants to do (no niche), suggesting the tool setup and recorded first-party only (preferences.startingIntents plus one engagement-ledger row, never track() and so never GA4 or a pixel). The plan stays a ?plan= hint shown on the last step. Selectors are the members kit's small `.chip` pills (a selected one is solid ink) with sprite icons.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const w=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/new/create-space-wizard.tsx','utf8');const pg=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/new/page.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!w.includes('SparkShell'))bad.push('wizard is not on the Spark kit');if(!pg.includes('parsePlanHint(params.plan)'))bad.push('page does not read ?plan=');if(!w.includes('createWizardSteps(SPACE_MANIFEST)'))bad.push('steps are not read off the manifest');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1201: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the wizard leaves the Spark kit, stops reading ?plan=, or stops deriving its steps from the manifest.
